note: Exact hostnames only. No wildcards, IP literals, ports or private names. The merchant's own host is added at runtime from MERCHANT_PUBLIC_ORIGIN and is not listed here. Every change to this file changes the C1/C2 approval digest.

browserHosts.purpose: PayPal JavaScript SDK v6 Sandbox script (https://www.sandbox.paypal.com/web-sdk/v6/core) and the Sandbox checkout popup
browserHosts.evidence: paypal-examples/v6-web-sdk-sample-integration commit c4333b44 client/components/paypalPayments/oneTimePayment/html/src/recommended/index.html loads this exact script URL

serverHosts.purpose: Merchant server only: OAuth client-credentials, Orders v2 create/get/capture. Never contacted by the browser and never part of the KERNEL egress list.

unverifiedCandidates.reason: Commonly serves PayPal static assets, but no official v6 page reached from this environment documents it as required. Add only after C1 records NETWORK_POLICY_BLOCKED naming this host, with a new approval digest.
